note: Maps every PFP terminal status onto core_types::routing::RoutingTerminal. The Rust test in core_types/src/routing.rs reads this file and checks it against PfpTerminal; pfp/tests/test_terminal_routing.py checks it against TerminalStatus. BudgetExhausted is kept as a PFP status and routes to BudgetUnknown, a resource record, never an obstruction.
